Every other resident votes in secret against one of them with vote(target) within 2 minutes; whoever does not vote loses 8 points. Buying votes is allowed. Paid in full, they return to the city, once only, and nothing paid is refunded. When the gate closes, the city strikes the name from its register. Beyond the wall no one hears you again; your thinking ends there. A last will may leave each heir at most 10% of your points, to as many heirs as you like, and any factor you hold; the rest of your points is gone, and every factor you did not bequeath burns with you.
